raw_response:
I was lucky to get FISP coupons again this season, so I will use chemical fertilizer on this main maize plot — without it the yields are too poor to feed my family. I will plant the hybrid seed that comes with the program because it gives bigger cobs than our local seed. I cannot afford pesticides or herbicides for food crops, and there is no irrigation here in Balaka, so we depend entirely on the rains. My wife and children will work this plot with me, and I may hire a couple of days of labor when the weeds grow thick.
